title: 16_anchor (Trinity Anchor)
description: Trinity Anchor artifact for Step 16. Declares the full scope of a multi-milestone implementation, holds one row per roadmap milestone with its status, and is the cross-milestone drift-detection surface. Does NOT carry a per-FR checklist — that detail lives in each 16a milestone plan. Does NOT carry execution or review sections — those are milestone-plan concerns.

artifact_role.description: Identifies this artifact as the Trinity Anchor. Must always be the string 'anchor'.

plan.description: Anchor-level plan: scope declaration, accumulated ambiguities, drift monitoring schedule, and milestone ownership registry.

summary.description: High-level scope summary for the full multi-milestone implementation.

functional_summary.description: 1-3 sentences describing the full implementation scope: the capability delivered, primary actors, and key constraints across all milestones.

scope_in.description: Items explicitly included across all milestones. Each string should name a concrete capability, endpoint, or system boundary. At least one entry is required so cross-milestone drift detection has a non-empty comparison surface.

items.description: A concrete scope item included in this implementation.

scope_out.description: Items explicitly excluded from all milestones. A milestone whose scope_in contains one of these values is in contradiction with the anchor. May be empty on a fresh anchor with no exclusions.

items.description: A concrete scope item excluded from this implementation.

ambiguities.description: Open ambiguities across all Trinity cycles. An empty array on a fresh anchor is valid.

drift.description: Drift monitoring log. Records the drift checks that have been run across milestone cycles. An empty checks array is valid on a fresh anchor.

items.description: Description of a drift check performed or scheduled. Must be a meaningful prose entry containing at least two words. Example: 'Verified ms-auth scope_in does not overlap anchor scope_out (2026-04-10)'.

checks.description: Drift checks performed or planned across milestone cycles. Each string documents what was checked and when.

milestone_index.description: Registry of all milestones covered by this anchor: one status row per roadmap milestone. Each row names the milestone it is about, its progress status and the checklist ID namespace its plan uses. An empty array is valid on a fresh anchor before any milestone plans are created.

items.description: A status record about one roadmap milestone. It is created and deleted, never retired, so it carries no lifecycle.

anchor_id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier of this anchor row. Suggested form: 'anchor-' followed by the milestone id. Example: 'anchor-ms-account-recovery'.

about.description: The one Step 14 roadmap milestone this row is about, as a one-item array. Example: ["ms-account-recovery"]. Anti-pattern: naming several milestones (one row per milestone) or a task.

status.description: Optional; an absent status reads as 'pending'. Progress status of this milestone: 'pending' (default), 'in_progress', 'deferred' or 'done'. Written by the milestone commands, not by hand. 'deferred' requires deferral_reason; 'done' requires close.

deferral_reason.description: Why the milestone was deferred. Required when status is 'deferred'. Example: 'Waits for the payment provider contract.'

close.description: How the milestone was closed. Required when status is 'done'. Further fields of the close record belong to the milestone commands.

signed_off_by.description: Who signed the milestone off. The literal 'legacy-migration' marks a milestone that was already done before the migration to this shape; it requires source.

source.description: Names the legacy status source this close was taken from. Required when signed_off_by is 'legacy-migration'.

checklist_id_prefix.description: SCREAMING_SNAKE prefix namespace for checklist IDs in this milestone's 16a plan (e.g., 'AUTH', 'PAYMENT', 'USER_MGMT'). Must be unique across milestone_index entries to prevent cross-milestone ID collisions.

summary.description: One-line status summary for this milestone. Example: 'Auth token issuance — 3/5 checklist items verified, CI green'.

allOf.description: Inherits shared step-base properties ($schema, id, owner, created_at, canonical_refs_used).
